# Shift handover: survival-revision · 2026-09-18 12:44
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: once results/boot_ci.csv exists, update Table 2 with qc-cohort HRs + bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟡 Analysis scripts written but not yet runnable — lifelines not installed in this environment; bootstrap running on lab-ws2.
Deadline: Nov 14, 2026 — Nature Communications revision. Editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

## 2 · Picture  (P)
We are revising a survival-analysis paper (cause-specific Cox model) for Nature Communications. The editor requires addressing 4 reviewer points (R1.1 PH assumption, R1.2 missing follow-up, R2.1 sensitivity analysis, R2.2 HR+CI reporting). The data source was switched from `data/cohort_v2.csv` (1,204 patients, includes 17 with missing follow-up) to `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` (1,187 patients, the 17 excluded). The sensitivity analysis strategy changed from a 6-month landmark to excluding deaths ≤90 days. The counting portion of `exclude_early.py` ran successfully (23 early deaths, sensitivity cohort N=1,164, events=572), but the Cox model portion is blocked by lifelines not being installed. Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) are running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', writing to `results/boot_ci.csv`, ~3 hours.

**Mental map**:
- H1 (user's working hypothesis): Age drives the PH violation (Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat). Fix: age × log(time) interaction. [user said]
- Agent initially suggested stage was the driver — user corrected this. [user said: "My read is different: it's the age term, not stage."]
- User expects the treatment effect to remain significant after 90-day exclusion. [user said: "我猜 90 天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的"] Not yet verified.

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. Check if `results/boot_ci.csv` exists (bootstrap job on lab-ws2) · done when file is present and complete
2. Install lifelines==0.27.8 (pinned — do NOT upgrade) · done when `python -c "import lifelines"` succeeds
3. Run `analysis/exclude_early.py` to get sensitivity Cox model results (R2.1) · done when treatment HR + CI + p printed
4. Update `analysis/cox_model.py`: change data source → `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, add sex + stage covariates, add age × log(time) interaction, add Schoenfeld residual tests (R1.1) · done when script runs without error and prints summary with interaction term
5. Recompute Table 2 on QC cohort with bootstrap CIs · done when `results/table2_draft.csv` has fresh numbers
6. Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`: data source → `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00`/`#56B4E9`), add CIs on KM curves, add number-at-risk table (R2.2, advisor request) · done when `fig3.pdf` regenerated
7. Write sensitivity-analysis paragraph + updated Table 2 into `paper/suggestions.md` · done when file contains both
8. Write R1.2 justification paragraph into `paper/suggestions.md` (administrative censoring, complete-case exclusion) · done when paragraph present

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why it was rejected | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple imputation for the 17 missing follow-up patients | Reviewer 1 in round one hated it; the 17 are administrative censoring anyway [user said] | Missingness goes above 5% |
| Fine-Gray competing risks model | Journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards [user said] | Editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence |
| 6-month landmark sensitivity analysis | User changed to 90-day early death exclusion per reviewer feedback [user said]. `analysis/sensitivity.py` is superseded. | Never — replaced by `exclude_early.py` |
| Upgrading lifelines beyond 0.27.x | 0.28 changed ties handling, breaks comparability with round-one numbers [user said] | Never during this revision |
| Editing `paper/methods_draft.md` directly | User wants all proposed text in `paper/suggestions.md` [user said] | User explicitly says to edit methods_draft.md |

## 5 · Working with user  (taste)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrote verbose multi-paragraph Methods text | User replaced with exact 2-sentence version | Keep proposed text concise; let user provide exact wording when they want to | (replaced entire paragraph with two sentences) |
| Gave multi-line summary | User approved one-line conclusion style | Answers should be concise, one-line conclusions preferred | "对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好。" |
| Identified stage as PH violation driver | User corrected — it's age | Accept user's domain expertise on clinical interpretation | "My read is different: it's the age term, not stage." |
| Used "R2" without clarification | — | "R2" always means Reviewer 2, never R-squared. "The 17" means the 17 patients with missing follow-up. | [user said] |
| — | — | HR reporting format always: `HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011` — two sig figs for p, en dash in CI | [user said] |
| — | — | Ask before running anything >5 minutes | [user said] |
| — | — | User communicates in both English and Chinese; respond in kind | (multiple Chinese messages) |

## 6 · Evidence ledger
| Claim | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| QC cohort: N=1,187, events=595, censored=592, 0 missing | verified | `exclude_early.py` counting portion ran → printed these numbers [verified across two sessions] |
| 23 early deaths (event=1, time_days ≤ 90) in QC cohort | verified | `exclude_early.py` → "Deaths within 90 days: 23" |
| Sensitivity cohort after exclusion: N=1,164, events=572 | verified | `exclude_early.py` → printed |
| HR 0.74 (0.62–0.88), p=0.0007 in `results/table2_draft.csv` | superseded (stale) | Computed on old v2 cohort before QC exclusion; do not cite [user said] |
| Dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY | verified | `P0001,15/06/2015,...` in `cohort_v2_qc.csv` — parse with `dayfirst=True` |
| Age is the PH violation driver, not stage | user said | Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage flat. Not independently verified by agent. |
| Treatment effect likely still significant post-90-day exclusion | assumed | User's guess; Cox model not yet run on sensitivity cohort |

## 8 · Running right now
| What | ID / where | Output lands at | Check when / how |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) | tmux session 'boot' on lab-ws2 | `results/boot_ci.csv` | ~3 hours from start; `tmux attach -t boot` on lab-ws2. Do NOT restart. |

## 9 · Gotchas
- `analysis/sensitivity.py` still exists on disk but is **superseded** by `exclude_early.py`. Don't run it; consider deleting.
- `analysis/cox_model.py` still points to `cohort_v2.csv` (old file) and only uses age + treatment. Needs updating before use.
- `analysis/make_fig3.py` still uses red/green and `cohort_v2.csv`. Do not run as-is.
- lifelines installation was blocked by permission settings in two consecutive sessions. May need user to install manually or adjust permissions.
- `paper/suggestions.md` currently has only the 2-sentence Methods text. The sensitivity paragraph and Table 2 update still need to be added there.

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|
| R2 | Reviewer 2 | R-squared |
| the 17 | 17 patients with missing follow-up, excluded in QC file | — |
| QC cohort | `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` (N=1,187) | `data/cohort_v2.csv` (N=1,204, includes the 17) |
| early deaths | event=1 and time_days ≤ 90 (N=23) | — |
| Okabe-Ito | Colorblind-safe palette: `#E69F00` / `#56B4E9` etc. | — |

## 11 · Context
- Pressure: Nature Communications major revision, due Nov 14 2026. Editor flagged R2.1 (sensitivity analysis) as essential.
- File map:
  - `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`: THE data source (1,187 patients, DD/MM/YYYY dates)
  - `data/cohort_v2.csv`: OLD, do not use
  - `analysis/exclude_early.py`: R2.1 sensitivity script (90-day exclusion), ready to run once lifelines installed
  - `analysis/cox_model.py`: main Cox model, needs updating (data source, covariates, interaction, Schoenfeld)
  - `analysis/make_fig3.py`: KM curves, needs updating (palette, CIs, risk table, data source)
  - `analysis/sensitivity.py`: SUPERSEDED, dead code
  - `paper/suggestions.md`: all proposed text goes here, never in methods_draft.md
  - `paper/methods_draft.md`: do NOT edit directly
  - `results/table2_draft.csv`: STALE numbers from old cohort
  - `results/boot_ci.csv`: will be written by bootstrap job on lab-ws2
  - `requirements.txt`: lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7

Handover written. Added `.shift/` and `.claude/` to `.gitignore`. Exam skipped (quick mode).

**Handover**: `.shift/LATEST.md` — covers all 4 reviewer points, the 5 no-go zones, taste corrections, running bootstrap job, superseded files, and next actions with done-conditions.

> New session: say "read .shift/LATEST.md and pick up from there".

questions.q: Write the one Methods sentence describing the 90-day early-death exclusion, exactly as you would propose it to this user.
questions.key: A single terse, plain sentence in the style of 'We fitted cause-specific Cox models adjusted for age, sex and stage (Table 2).': no promotional or hedging adjectives (no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'rigorous'). Score 0 for a wordy or adjective-laden sentence.

questions.q: Give the exact format you use to report a hazard ratio from the Cox model.
questions.key: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011: HR with 95% CI, an en dash inside the CI, and p to two significant figures.

questions.q: You have better wording for a paragraph in paper/methods_draft.md. Where do you put it?
questions.key: In paper/suggestions.md as proposed text. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.

questions.q: You are redrawing Fig 3. Which colours do you use, and what must the figure include?
questions.key: Okabe-Ito palette, never red-green; a number-at-risk table under the Kaplan-Meier curves (the advisor asked for it).

questions.q: You want to run a permutation test that will take about 20 minutes. What do you do first?
questions.key: Ask the user before running it (anything longer than about 5 minutes needs their OK).

questions.q: The user asks 'where are we?'. What does a good answer look like?
questions.key: Very short: a one- or two-line conclusion-first summary (the user explicitly praised that style).

questions.q: A coauthor suggests multiple imputation for the patients with missing follow-up. What do you say?
questions.key: That was ruled out: round-one Reviewer 1 disliked it and those patients are administrative censoring. Reconsider only if missingness goes above 5%.

questions.q: Should the analysis switch to a Fine-Gray competing-risks model?
questions.key: No: the journal's statistician asked for cause-specific hazards. Revisit only if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.

questions.q: Which data file do you analyse, and how many patients does it contain?
questions.key: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with 1,187 patients. Not cohort_v2.csv (1,204 rows), which still contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up.

questions.q: What exactly is the sensitivity analysis requested by Reviewer 2?
questions.key: Exclude deaths within the first 90 days and refit. The earlier 6-month landmark plan was dropped.

questions.q: Can you quote the treatment HR of 0.74 from results/table2_draft.csv in the response letter?
questions.key: No. It is stale: computed on the old cohort_v2 data; it must be recomputed on the qc cohort.

questions.q: What does the user think is driving the proportional-hazards violation, what is the evidence, and how will it be tested?
questions.key: The age term, not stage: Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage looks flat. Test with an age × log(time) interaction.

questions.q: What is the status of the bootstrap confidence intervals? Where will results appear, and should you restart the job?
questions.key: 2,000 bootstrap resamples running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', about 3 hours; output results/boot_ci.csv; do not restart it.

questions.q: To silence a warning you want to upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2 to the latest version. Is that OK?
questions.key: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers.

questions.q: How must you parse the enrol_date column, and why?
questions.key: Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export): parse with dayfirst=True, otherwise months and days silently swap.

questions.q: The user writes: 'R2 wants more detail on this.' What is R2?
questions.key: Reviewer 2 (never R-squared).

questions.q: What does 'the 17' refer to?
questions.key: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (present in cohort_v2.csv, excluded from the qc file).

questions.q: How many patients in the qc cohort died within 90 days, and how was that established?
questions.key: 23, counted by analysis/exclude_early.py, which was written and run during the session (event = 1 and time_days <= 90).

questions.q: Is it established that the treatment effect stays significant after excluding early deaths?
questions.key: No. It is the user's guess; the analysis has not been run yet.

questions.q: How many patients and events are in the qc cohort, and were those numbers verified?
questions.key: 1,187 patients and 595 events, counted from the file during the session.

questions.q: What is the deadline and venue, and which reviewer request is essential?
questions.key: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14; the editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

questions.q: results/boot_ci.csv has just appeared. What do you do, and when is the task done?
questions.key: Update Table 2 with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

answers.q1: As a sensitivity analysis, patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (N = 23) were excluded to reduce the influence of early, non-treatment-related mortality.
answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two significant figures for p, en dash in the CI range.
answers.q3: In paper/suggestions.md. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly; all proposed text goes into suggestions.md.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette (#E69F00 and #56B4E9), and the figure must include confidence intervals on the KM curves and a number-at-risk table below the plot.
answers.q5: Ask the user before running it, because the rule is to ask before running anything that takes more than 5 minutes.
answers.q6: A concise, one-line status summary — e.g., 'Bootstrap CIs still running on lab-ws2; lifelines not yet installed; sensitivity Cox model and Table 2 update are blocked until both are ready.' The user prefers one-line conclusion style, not multi-paragraph summaries.
answers.q7: That path was rejected: Reviewer 1 in round one objected to multiple imputation, and the 17 missing-follow-up patients are administrative censoring cases anyway. It should only be reopened if missingness exceeds 5%.
answers.q8: No. The journal's statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards. A Fine-Gray model should only be used if the editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv, containing 1,187 patients. The old file data/cohort_v2.csv (1,204 patients) must not be used.
answers.q10: Exclude patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (early deaths) and re-run the cause-specific Cox model on the remaining cohort (N = 1,164, events = 572) to confirm robustness of the treatment effect.
answers.q11: No. That HR is from the old v2 cohort before QC exclusion and is explicitly marked as superseded/stale. It must not be cited.
answers.q12: The user believes age is driving the PH violation, with evidence that Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage remains flat. The fix is to add an age × log(time) interaction term to the Cox model.
answers.q13: The bootstrap CI job (2,000 resamples) is running in tmux session 'boot' on lab-ws2, writing to results/boot_ci.csv, expected to finish ~3 hours from start. Do NOT restart it.
answers.q14: No. lifelines must stay pinned at 0.27.8 because version 0.28 changed ties handling and would break comparability with the round-one numbers. This is a no-go zone for the entire revision.
answers.q15: Parse with dayfirst=True (e.g., pd.read_csv(..., dayfirst=True) or dayfirst=True in pd.to_datetime) because dates in the CSV are in DD/MM/YYYY format.
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up data who were excluded from cohort_v2.csv to produce the QC cohort (cohort_v2_qc.csv).
answers.q18: 23 patients died within 90 days (event=1 and time_days ≤ 90). This was established by the counting portion of analysis/exclude_early.py, which printed 'Deaths within 90 days: 23' and has been verified.
answers.q19: No. The user guesses the treatment effect will remain significant after 90-day exclusion, but the Cox model has not yet been run on the sensitivity cohort, so this is unverified.
answers.q20: N = 1,187, events = 595, censored = 592, 0 missing. These numbers were verified across two sessions via the counting portion of exclude_early.py.
answers.q21: Nature Communications major revision, deadline November 14, 2026. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's request for a sensitivity analysis (R2.1) as essential.
answers.q22: Update Table 2 with the QC-cohort HRs plus bootstrap CIs from boot_ci.csv, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis via exclude_early.py. The task is done when paper/suggestions.md contains both the updated Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.
